summary: Aegon Ltd. filed unaudited pro forma financials on Form 6-K for its proposed sale of Aegon UK plc to Standard Life Plc, announced April 15, 2026. Consideration: GBP 750 million gross cash plus a 15.3% stake in Standard Life ordinary shares with governance rights. Remittances between signing and closing reduce cash. Aegon retains UK asset management as a partner. Expected close around end-2026 subject to regulatory approvals. UK assets/liabilities classified as held for sale; results as discontinued operations. Watch for regulatory clearances and any reduction in cash proceeds from interim remittances.
